metadata.name: UpdateShippingAddress
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to update the card shipping address.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Example:12345

request_fields.name: CardSequenceNumber
request_fields.description: Card Sequence Number.Physical Card order can be uniquely identify by combination of Admin Number and Card Sequence Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 1. Example: 2354 Main road Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 2. Example:xyz Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingCity
request_fields.description: Shipping address city name. Example: chicago Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShippingState
request_fields.description: Sate of the shipping address. Example:AK(Alaska) Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: ShippingCountry
request_fields.description: Shipping address Country name. Example:US(United States) Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
request_fields.description: Zip code of the shipping address. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Example:12345 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card. Example: John K Peter Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IsPermanentAddress
request_fields.description: Flag to mark permanent address same as mailing address. Valid Values: 0 - No, 1- Yes Example: 1

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Shipment delivery mechanism. Valid Values: 0 =	Standard 1 =	Priority 2 = Overnight 3=Standard Exp 4=Priority Exp 5=Overnight Exp Example: 0 Condition:Values 3,4,5 are only applicable for Perfect Plastic Card Vendor Allowable Values: 9

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
